events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Rondo (NOP) that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Green (MEM) legally contests Cousins' (NOP) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Rondo (NOP) makes contact to Evans' (MEM) arm, affecting his ability to make the pass.
Moore (NOP) sets the screen on Green (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Cousins (NOP) sets the screen on Ennis III (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Incidental or immaterial] Gasol (MEM) grabs and pulls Miller's (MEM) jersey.
Gasol (MEM) cleanly makes contact with the ball on Miller's (NOP) driving shot attempt.
Cousins (NOP) makes incidental contact with Chalmers (MEM) that does not affect his SQBR.
[Detectable with stop watch] Evans (MEM) is in the lane without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
Gasol (MEM) cleanly deflects the ball away from Cosuins (NOP).
Gasol (MEM) and Cousins (NOP) make incidental contact with each other during the loose ball.
Rondo (NOP) commits a take foul on Evans (MEM).
Harrison (MEM) makes incidental contact with Holiday (NOP) that does not affect his SQBR.

Evans (MEM) legally contests Moore's (NOP) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
